item.description: ### Fixed - **Subagents that never really existed no longer linger under a session.** After a large fan-out, a few rows could stay under the session as "running" long after every agent had finished, until the session ended. Perch now removes a subagent row once it has no record of its own on disk and has been silent for three minutes. Agents that are really working are not affected, however long a single step takes.
